title: Tomato seafood stew
summary: Tomato seafood stew is a mediterranean dinner built around raw king prawns and mussels, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Tomato seafood stew. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add raw king prawns and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and mussels.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until cod fillets is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Tomato seafood stew before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Tomato seafood stew.
